privacy.title: गोपनीयता नीति
privacy.heading: ACOMI Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how ACOMI handles information when you use the ACOMI mobile application, website, and related services.

about.title: 1. About ACOMI
about.body:
ACOMI is a property and operations management application designed to help users manage spaces such as PGs, hostels, messes, co-living spaces, and rental properties.

This Privacy Policy applies to information processed through the ACOMI application and website.

informationWeCollect.title: 2. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.body:
Depending on the features you use, ACOMI may collect and process the following information:

Account information

When you create an ACOMI account, we may collect:

• Mobile number
• Name
• Password credentials in protected form
• Other profile information that you choose to provide

Passwords are stored in protected/hashed form and are not stored as plain-text passwords.

Property and operational information

If you use ACOMI to manage a property or space, information may include:

• Property or space details
• Building, room and bed information
• Occupancy information
• Member or tenant information
• Meal and menu information
• Payment records
• Complaints
• Invitations and related operational information

The information stored depends on the features you use.

Documents and images

Where the application provides functionality for uploading images or documents, you may provide information such as:

• Profile photographs
• Property-related images
• Payment proofs
• Other documents or images submitted through the application

Please do not upload information that is not required for the relevant purpose.

howWeUse.title: 3. How We Use Information
howWeUse.body:
ACOMI uses information to provide and operate its services, including to:

• Create and authenticate user accounts
• Provide access to the features of the application
• Manage properties and spaces
• Manage members and occupancy
• Manage meals and menus
• Maintain payment and operational records
• Handle complaints and operational requests
• Provide notifications and other service-related communications
• Maintain and improve the reliability and security of the service

We use information for the purposes for which it was provided and for operating the ACOMI service.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing of Information
sharing.body:
ACOMI does not sell your personal information.

Information may be made available to other users of a property or space where this is necessary for the operation of that space and permitted by the relevant functionality and user roles.

For example, information associated with a property may be accessible to authorized owners, managers, staff, tenants, or other participants depending on their role and the features being used.

Information may also be processed by service providers or infrastructure used to operate ACOMI where necessary to provide the service.

We do not claim that information is shared with a particular third party unless that third-party service is actually used by ACOMI.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.body:
ACOMI takes reasonable measures to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or disclosure.

Authentication credentials are handled using protected mechanisms, and communications with ACOMI services are intended to use secure network connections where supported.

However, no internet-based service can guarantee absolute security.

dataRetention.title: 6. Data Retention
dataRetention.body:
ACOMI retains information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide the services and operate the associated account, property, or business functions.

Certain operational information may need to remain associated with a property or space even when an individual user's account is deleted, where that information is necessary for the continued operation or record-keeping of the property or service.

We do not state a specific retention period where one has not been formally defined.

accountDeletion.title: 7. Account Deletion
accountDeletion.body:
You may request deletion of your ACOMI account through the account deletion functionality provided by ACOMI.

When an account deletion request is completed, ACOMI will delete or otherwise remove personal account information associated with the account, subject to information that may need to be retained for legitimate operational, security, legal, or other permitted purposes.

Information belonging to a shared property or space may not be deleted simply because one user's account is deleted. Such information may continue to be required for the operation and records of that property or space.

Where applicable, personal information associated with shared records may be removed or anonymized rather than deleting the underlying operational record.

yourChoices.title: 8. Your Choices
yourChoices.body:
You can:

• Access and update information through the available ACOMI functionality.
• Choose what information to provide where the relevant feature is optional.
• Request deletion of your account using the available account deletion process.
• Contact ACOMI regarding questions or requests concerning your personal information.

childrensPrivacy.title: 9. Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.body:
ACOMI is intended for use by individuals who can legally use the service.

ACOMI is not specifically directed toward children.

We do not knowingly request children to provide personal information for purposes unrelated to the service.

thirdPartyServices.title: 10. Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.body:
ACOMI may rely on third-party infrastructure or services to operate certain parts of the application.

Where third-party services process information on behalf of ACOMI, their processing may be subject to their respective terms and privacy policies.

The specific third-party services used by ACOMI may change over time.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.body:
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to the ACOMI service, data practices, or applicable requirements.

When the policy is updated, the revised version will be published on this page with an updated effective date.

contact.title: 12. Contact
contact.body: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how ACOMI handles information, you can contact us through the contact mechanism provided on the ACOMI website or application.
